atAGlance: Ốc hương rang muối is sweet sea snails roasted with salt, usually with chili, garlic, rau răm, and lime-pepper salt dip or ginger fish sauce.
whatItIs: Ốc hương rang muối are spotted babylon snails tossed with salt, chili, garlic, and aromatics. The shells carry a savory dry crust.
howToEnjoy: Pull the snails from the shells and taste the salt crust before adding lime or chili. Eat slowly; this is a sharing plate, not a rush meal.
howLocalsOrder: Order ốc hương rang muối at an ốc shop when you want a fragrant shellfish plate. Ask for less chili before the snails are tossed.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese ốc shops, ốc hương is prized for aroma and chew, and rang muối makes the shell itself part of the flavor experience.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
